entities.name: Rosi Sánchez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Rosaura del Carmen Sánchez Luján, known as Rosi Sánchez is a Spanish former basketball player who played most of her career in local club Sandra Gran Canaria and in the Italian League. She won two Spanish Cups, two Italian Leagues and the 1999 Ronchetti Cup. With the Spanish national team she won two bronze medals in the EuroBasket. She played in the EuroCup Women from 2006 to 2011 with four different teams.
